fallbacks: No bits-ui primitive here — plain DOM carries the source's own carousel roles/aria.

dataFlow.reason: Presentational banner fed by a `messages` prop; no route data.

guards: All browser APIs live inside $effect or event handlers, which never run during SSR; server render shows the default-open bar.

verification.evidence: 0 errors / 0 warnings in announcement-bar files (whole-project run).

verification.purpose: Port gates: files, verbatim CSS, prop parity, manifest

gaps: Phase 1 still-port by design: no motion library wired. The face rise/blur swap, the viewport height spring, the digit-roll countdown, the pause-ring progress sweep and the dismiss collapse all render as static end-states; rotation and dismissal swap/close instantly.
ARC's forwardRef became a $bindable `ref` prop with bind:this on the section.
Announcement.message is typed `string | Snippet`; ARC takes any ReactNode. Plain strings cover ARC's documented usage; rich content passes a Snippet instead of JSX.
Remembered dismissal is read in $effect (client-only), so a dismissed bar can flash on first paint; ARC hides before paint via useLayoutEffect. The write path (set on dismiss) matches.
Height measuring uses bind:offsetHeight + $effect instead of ResizeObserver (equivalent, Svelte-idiomatic).
Direction-aware face variants (next rises from below, previous from above) collapse to one instant swap; direction state returns with Phase 2.
lucide-react → @lucide/svelte for the CTA, chevron, pause/play and close icons.
